full_prompt: Asset type: native SNES fighter animation source atlas.

Give Reston a fuller, very short dense near-black buzz cap: dark coverage from both temples over the crown, with a modest forward hairline, while retaining the mature high forehead. Apply the same hair silhouette consistently to all 16 poses.

Preserve the same middle-aged broad-faced bearded Reston fighter in every existing cell. Preserve the exact 1254x1254 square canvas, 4x4 cell grid, cell placement, pose order, figure positions, scale, feet baseline and transparent margins.

Change only scalp hair coverage and hairline. Preserve every body pixel, face structure, beard, eyes, nose, jaw, costume, limbs, hands, shoes, shadows, pose anatomy, and all frame spacing. Avoid bangs, pompadour, long hair, gray/brown wispy strands, facial redesign, younger hairline, effects, labels, text, watermark, pose drift, repainting of clothing or body, altered canvas/grid, inconsistent per-pose hair, bald crescent, exposed crown, halo, extra characters or background.
